notes.title: Sledders Custom Racing Update 🏁
notes.notes:
The Custom Racing update has dropped and is available on all platforms!

You are now able to make custom races in game and race your friends anywhere on the map. Put your check points down and see who finishes first… and who last!

To add to the update, we will also be having a 25% Discount during the Daily Deal on the Front Page of Steam starting 7PM CEST.

Check out the Custom Racing Trailer here:
[previewyoutube=Ul6uMc2iPC0;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: The 3rd hotfix is now live!
notes.notes:
3rd Hotfix is now out!

Patch Notes
- Password-protected servers.
- Fixed game being randomly unresponsive/crashing when riding Polaris and some retro sleds. Probability was highest when riding north/east on Woodland or High Peaks.
- Utility sleds balancing.
- Skis were not turning for other players in multiplayer.
- When cancelling the spawn point removal by enter/gamepad player was spawned to the spawn point.
- Snow trail reacts to turning skis.
- When hosting or joining a multiplayer game on the same map, the environment ambience sounds were stopped.
- Spawn points cannot be placed in water anymore.
- Few watchtowers did not have colliders.
- Removed visual duplicate rear suspension parts from Shredders.
- Train in High Peaks had the wrong mesh profile and allowed getting under it.
- Corrected Kitty stats bars.
- SKS minor visual fix.

notes.title: The second hotfix after the release is now live.
notes.notes:
Second hotfix has dropped!

Patch Notes:
- Cross play UI polished on consoles
- Players were having problems joining servers that already had 10+ players, this should now be fixed!
- On the Steam version, players were able to start loading levels multiple times in a row.
- Console versions were missing some sound effects.
- Some snowmobile models and texture changes were applied.

notes.title: The first hotfix after the release is now live.
notes.notes:
There is mostly bug fixes and polishing based on your feedback. 

**Patch notes:**
-Added filters to multiplayer game browsing
-Turbo sound work on consoles (a few other sounds still to be fixed)
-Fixed chat Q, E, M, and back button issues
-Back button works in report player form
-Most achievements unlock afterward if they have failed to unlock in the past (achievements were broken on Xbox at launch)
-Lot of minor sled and scene fixes
The current multiplayer game name can be seen in the map view
-Minor improvement to the snow trail look
-Made hosting/joining multiplayer a bit more clear

An update that brings new features will come later. Soon(ish)

notes.title: Sledders Game Update and Release Schedule
notes.notes:
[b]Hello Sledders Community,
[/b]
The first snow blankets in Finland are starting a new snowmobile season. We're thrilled to announce that our latest update is now live! 

Big November Update to Enhance Your Sledding Experience:

[list]
[*] Getting Stuck Mechanism
[*] New Spawning Mechanism
[*] Revamped Garage
[*] Expanded Character Customization
[*] Female Driver Option
[*] Cinematic Camera Zoom
[*] In-Game Chat
[*] Hop-Over/Wrong Foot Forward Techniques
[*] Re-worked Snow Physics
[*] New Sleds and Locations
[/list]
  
[h2]Updated Release Schedule for Sledders 1.0 and Console Versions
[/h2]We understand that the wait for the full release of Sledders and its debut on consoles has been filled with anticipation. To ensure we deliver a game that meets our community's high standards (and ours), we must postpone the release of Sledders 1.0 and the console versions to February 2025. This decision was not made lightly, but we think this is best.

[previewyoutube=HtWvAhM5RQE;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]A word for our community
[/h2]We appreciate your patience and enthusiasm for Sledders. While the wait for the full release extends a little longer, we are excited to share this “Season start” update as a token of our gratitude for your ongoing support. We are confident these new features will make your gameplay even more interesting. We hope this tides you over as we put the finishing touches on what we believe will be a fantastic release in February. We keep working our asses off.

notes.title: Update 0.7.2 for Sledders
notes.notes:
Today, we're releasing the 0.7.2 update for "Sledders" on Steam. Here's what to expect:

Multiplayer Improvements:

[list]
[*] Vehicle Switching: Now you can change vehicles directly in multiplayer mode.
[*] Game Transitions: Move between different multiplayer and singleplayer games without returning to the garage or disconnecting.
[*] Connection Stability: We've worked on fixing the connection issues that were disrupting gameplay.
[*] Additional Updates:
[/list]

[list]
[*] Snow Interaction: The issue with snow compression near the world origin has been addressed.
[*] Minimap Accuracy: Player indicators on the minimap now show the correct orientation.
[*] Character Model Optimization: Character models have been optimized for better performance.
[*] Settings Adjustments: The typo in the "Reverse by braking" setting has been corrected, and the V-Sync setting now functions properly.
[/list]

For more details, check out the update on our Steam page: Sledders on Steam.

Enjoy the new features, and happy sledding!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2486740/Sledders/

notes.title: Slush Season is Here! 🌨️ 1st Major Update for Sledders Now Live! 🌨️
notes.notes:
Yo, Sledheads!

We're thrilled to announce the first major update since the release of Sledders! This update is packed with features that will transform your sledding experience, taking it to new heights – literally and figuratively.

What's New:
[list]
[*] Trails are here! Yes, indeed. We brought trails to Sledders. This addition required us to develop an entirely new physics model tailored for trail riding. Riding on hard-packed snow trails is different compared to plowing through deep snow.
[*] Roads! With road come… drumroll, please… DITCH BANGING! Prepare to take your sled airborne!
[*] New sleds on the block! We're expanding your garage with several new sleds, including an innovative design featuring a single rail.
[*] Customization options! Make your sled look like you want. Choose from a variety of C&A Pro skis, available in different colors, along with ROX Speed handguards and bar pads to make your sled truly yours.
[/list]

All these features debut with our new map, High Peaks. Challenge yourself with its tough lines and steep climbs, designed to push your skills to the limit.

We're eager to hear your thoughts on this update. Your feedback is invaluable to us as we continue to improve the Sledders experience. Let us know what you love, what you don't, and what you hope to see in the future.

Stay frosty and shred hard!

Sledders is currently 20% off on Steam! Don't miss your chance to join the action for just $19.99. The offer ends soon!

👉 Get Sledders on Steam [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2486740/Sledders/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/2486740/Sledders/[/url]

[list]
[*] New map: High Peaks

[*] Reverse gear
[*] Physics and suspension development
